perks.title: Statement-cycle points cap and reversals

perks.title: Point use, expiry and account conditions
perks.summary: Past-due/over-limit accounts cannot earn or use points until regularized. More than 12 months of inactivity or 60 days of delinquency can forfeit points, including Infinite points despite no age-based expiry. Transfers require the same primary holder and follow receiving-card rules.

perks.title: Redemption value is not a category earning bonus
perks.summary: The annex lists MXN0.10 per point for specified merchant sectors and MXN0.07 for others, subject to campaign/channel terms. Retrospective payment applies to eligible posted, undisputed single-payment purchases within 90 calendar days and removes original earned points; unavailable on Crea.

perks.title: Start introductory installments versus paid deferral
perks.summary: Purchases in the first 30 days automatically enter 3 interest-free installments and earn no standard points. These paid conversions are distinct from the introductory and merchant-funded MSI offers.

perks.title: No annual fee, but event fees apply

Start does not allow cash advances. Minimum payment keeps the account current but does not itself avoid financing interest.

perks.title: Start-specific contract restrictions
perks.summary: Start excludes cash withdrawals, credit transfers to own accounts and Efectivo Inmediato. Additional cards share the primary credit line, not new credit. Unpaid installment balances may move to ordinary revolving debt. The contract gives 20 calendar days after cutoff, with next-business-day payment when due on a bank holiday. Statement terms govern.

perks.title: Balance waiver on cardholder death
perks.summary: After notification with the death certificate, BBVA waives the balance as of the cardholder’s date of death. Authorized users remain liable for their spending after that date. This is a debt waiver, not a cash life-insurance payout; the clause states no separate payout amount or notification deadline.

perks.title: Product benefits
perks.summary: Mastercard benefits subject to their own terms; digital card and app controls.

perks.title: Additional cards
perks.summary: Share the credit line with adult additional cardholders; digital purchases and balance consultation through the BBVA app.

perks.title: Efectivo Inmediato
perks.summary: Cash financing offers are invitation-based and require BBVA credit assessment; fees and interest follow the accepted offer.

perks.title: Mastercard purchase protection
perks.summary: BBVA advertises eligible theft/damage within 45 days, up to USD100/event and USD200/year. The current Mexico-locale Standard Mastercard page has an issuing-territory list omitting Mexico and a Gold footer. Exact Mexico/Vive policy matching remains unresolved; the marketing limits are not certified applicable coverage.

perks.title: BBVA baggage insurance
perks.summary: Full eligible-card ticket payment and checked baggage on authorized regular passenger transport required. Worldwide coverage, at most 2 bags/ticket and 4/event; loss after 72 hours from the carrier claim. Per bag: up to MXN1,000 for delay expenses and MXN3,000 for loss. Delay reimburses documented expenses; approved settlement is credited through the bank. Leaflet advertises no deductible. Exclusions and claim documents apply.

perks.title: BBVA purchase insurance
perks.summary: Eligible goods fully paid with the card: qualifying material damage/violent theft within 100 days; limits USD2,000/item, 3,000/event, 10,000/year. Ordinary deductible 10%; specified valuables/art 25%. Mobile deductible conflicts: leaflet 25%, full-policy clause 5 otherwise 10%. Annex permits at least MXN500, while insurer terms exclude MXN500 or less; exact equality is unresolved. Domestic purchases covered in Mexico; abroad-bought goods worldwide only with an eligible international card. Other insurance pays first; exclusions, purchase proof and claim documents apply. Approved indemnity credits the card account.

perks.title: Statement-cycle points cap and reversals
perks.summary: Normal purchase points per statement are capped at the card earning rate multiplied by one credit line; special-campaign points are excluded from that calculation. Cash and regular installment purchases do not earn standard points. Converting a purchase to installments later removes its original points. Specific temporary campaigns may differ.

perks.title: Point use, expiry and account conditions
perks.summary: Past-due/over-limit accounts cannot earn or use points until regularized. More than 12 months of inactivity or 60 days of delinquency can forfeit points, including Infinite points despite no age-based expiry. Transfers require the same primary holder and follow receiving-card rules.

perks.title: Redemption value is not a category earning bonus
perks.summary: The annex lists MXN0.10 per point for specified merchant sectors and MXN0.07 for others, subject to campaign/channel terms. These are redemption values, not earning multipliers or unrestricted cash. Retrospective payment applies to eligible posted, undisputed single-payment purchases within 90 calendar days and removes original earned points; unavailable on Crea.

normalEarningCap.note: Not an unlimited points rate and not an annual cap. Actual cap depends on the card credit line; no universal fixed peso ceiling inferred.

perks.summary: 24/7 assistance with reservations, tickets, travel planning and gifts. The assistance does not make purchased services complimentary.

perks.title: Momentos redemption options

perks.title: Banamex experiences
perks.summary: Participating presales, Premium Weekend and Bon Appetit promotions depend on current merchant terms. Interest-free installment promotions do not earn Momentos points.

perks.title: Companion-certificate booking restrictions
perks.summary: Personal, single-use adult economy round-trip certificate; primary holder must travel and pay with the participating card. Both travelers share the itinerary. perks.title: Temporary airport takeaway meal

perks.title: Travel-redemption provider restrictions

perks.title: Momentos eligibility and point expiry

Additional cards earn for the primary account but cannot redeem.

Guests and children aged 5+ consume visits where an allowance applies; unused visits do not carry forward. Physical eligible card and same-day departure boarding passes required. Entry at most two hours before domestic or three hours before international departure. Services, availability and conduct rules apply.

perks.title: LoungeKey airport lounges
perks.summary: 10 complimentary visits per calendar year for the primary card, and independently 10 for each eligible additional card—not a pooled account allowance. Each person consumes a visit; no rollover. Extra-visit price conflict: dedicated issuer page USD35/person versus live product FAQ USD32; applicable issuer-plan charge unconfirmed. Active card required; previously registered cards may use app QR. Preauthorization applies and complimentary holds are released within seven business days. Operator terms still apply.

perks.title: Travel-redemption provider restrictions
perks.summary: Point-funded travel is subject to live inventory and selected supplier/fare terms, not guaranteed free changes or refunds. Hotel local taxes, resort and incidental fees can remain payable unless the voucher includes them. Rental pickup requires a physical credit card with deposit capacity; prepaid points do not waive that requirement. Rental-rate insurance is not automatically included and is separate from any card-network insurance. Fixed-point flights, variable-price travel and the companion certificate have different conditions.

perks.title: Momentos eligibility and point expiry
perks.summary: Automatic program participation starts with card activation. Account must be current to earn/redeem; points are for personal use, not business or travel-agency activity. Returns/adjustments reduce eligible purchases. Points expire from their generation date, and unused points are forfeited immediately if the card is cancelled. Additional cards earn for the primary account but cannot redeem.

perks.title: Momentos cashback is not a card payment
perks.summary: Cashback redemption credits the enrolled card account, normally within seven business days; issuer may extend processing. It is not an ATM withdrawal and does not satisfy the minimum, total or other required statement payment. Keep making required payments. Redemption values vary by reward/card/channel; do not apply Premia’s fixed conversion rate.

perks.title: Fixed-price flight redemptions
perks.summary: The fixed-points flight matrix requires Mexico origin, round trip, sufficient points, normal account status and booking more than21days ahead under the detailed terms; no multi-destination itineraries. Variable-price or mixed-payment travel has different conditions. These reward flights are distinct from the conditional companion certificate.

perks.title: Conditional current T1 World Elite parking match

Active eligible BIN validation, AICM travel and availability apply. Current2026 offer ends December31; separate published T2 offer expired September30, so no current T2 entitlement established.

perks.title: Point expiry and forfeiture
perks.summary: Points expire 3 years from accrual, but cancellation, program termination or holder death forfeits unused points. Lost/stolen replacement preserves points, transferred within 5 business days after activation. Program abuse can also cause forfeiture.

perks.title: Points are not unrestricted cashback
perks.summary: App redemption covers eligible marked purchases over MXN100 from the last 3 months, excluding installments and pending charges. Merchant redemption requires participating physical POS, physical card, at least MXN50 and at most 3 transactions daily; no contactless/ecommerce/MSI. Additional users can redeem at POS, but only the primary holder can redeem in app or website.

perks.title: Airline transfer restrictions
perks.summary: Iberia Club publishes 1 Unique Point = 1 Avios, starting at 1,000; Santander requires 1,000-point blocks, same-holder accounts and irreversible transfers. perks.title: Conditional debt cancellation on death
perks.summary: The individual agreement provides balance insurance when the primary holder dies while current on payments, limited to the balance at death and granted credit limit. Written notice and a certified death certificate are required. Additional users remain liable for post-death spending and related charges; this is not a cash life-insurance payout.

perks.title: Network-specific purchase protection
perks.summary: Current-linked regional Visa Gold terms support 180-day purchase protection, subject to full payment, limits and exclusions. Warranty doubles the original warranty, capped at one extra year, for eligible original terms of 3 months–3 years. Price protection distinguishes 7-day online advertisements from 30-day traditional advertisements and requires a difference above USD25. Issuer participation and governing policy still control.

perks.title: Transferred Avios have separate expiry and award rules
perks.summary: Iberia transfers do not earn Elite Points or create a fixed cash value. Its general expiry rule is 36 months without qualifying earning/redemption, with exceptions; Santander Black’s no-age-expiry benefit does not carry over. Award seats, taxes and possible carrier charges still apply.

aliases: the platinum credit card american express

rules.note: 1 Membership Rewards point per USD-equivalent of eligible purchases, NOT per MXN or 1% cashback. Each purchase converted using transaction-day FX, rounded to nearest whole point. Merchant MSI earns per installment; automatic MSI earns on original purchase. Exclusions/current account apply. No verified broad category accelerator.

payment.avoidPurchaseInterest: Pay the statement amount designated payment to avoid interest by its due date; paying only the minimum does not avoid interest.

minimum.additionalContractWording: Hasta el 8% del saldo insoluto del periodo o hasta $500.00 M.N., el importe que resulte mayor.
minimum.caveat: Contract compares the applicable components and permits a higher minimum; the up-to-8%/up-to-500 wording is not encoded as an unconditional exact rate or flat minimum. Statement controls; minimum cannot exceed actual revolving balance.

payment.excessAboveMinimum: Applied first to the revolving balance bearing the highest interest rate.

borrowing.promotionalConditions: Current account and required minimum payments; two or more late payments within 12 months or one or more returned/rejected payments may end the promotional spread. Reassessment 12 months after increase may permit reduction.
borrowing.weeklyReferenceCalculation: Friday average of the last 30 published 28-day TIIEF rates including Friday; updated the following Wednesday until next update.
borrowing.interestBasis: Average daily balance multiplied by annual rate divided by 360, multiplied by actual days in the period. Revolving purchase interest calculated from transaction date.

foreignCurrencyBilling.reference: Applicable Banxico reference on authorization or processing date under clause 22; not Membership Rewards transaction-day conversion.
foreignCurrencyBilling.nonUSD: Generally converted to USD on processing date using prior-business-day interbank sources; local rules or prior third-party conversion may apply.

lossTheftAndDisputes.protectionAfterReport: Unauthorized charges after issuer receives report; previously authorized recurring charges may remain payable.
lossTheftAndDisputes.caveat: Provisional credit may be reversed with qualifying proof within the decision period. If no timely decision is provided, credited unrecognized charges cannot be reversed. A recognized valid charge may still accrue ordinary interest.

cancellation.refundCalculation: Annual fee charged multiplied by remaining covered days divided by total covered days; exclude termination day and include final covered day. Not a guaranteed full refund.

insuranceConditions.reviewScope: Selected complete relevant sections of current issuer-linked provider policies and card-specific guide; not all insurance documents or all pages. Limits remain subject to the applicable policy cover/certificate.

coverage: Total theft of eligible rented vehicle
rentalCar.rentalCollisionTheftCoverage: Policy permits declining or partially contracting rental-company collision/damage/theft cover; card guide says decline CDW/LDW or similar. Confirm applicable certificate before relying on partial cover.

repeatCoverage.condition: New eligible rental contract and eligible card payment; geographic alternative must remain in covered territory.

territorialConflict.cardGuide: Worldwide except Mexico, Afghanistan, Crimea, Cuba, Iran, North Korea, North Sudan, Syria and Venezuela
territorialConflict.policy: Refers card-specific territories to policy cover and issuer page; excludes circulation in Mexico/Cuba. Referenced legacy issuer page redirects to generic directory without card territory table.

exclusions: Partial theft unless consequent to covered total theft
Excluded vehicle types and commercial use
Ordinary wear and mechanical breakdown subject to policy exceptions

claim.initialFormCaveat: Policy also ties submission to leaving the territory of loss; do not substitute the180day supplementary-document period for initial notice/form deadlines.

purchaseProtection.thresholdWordingConflict: Agreement/guide require greater than50USD; general policy says greater than or equal to50USD. Exact50USD boundary unresolved; no broader eligibility promised.
purchaseProtection.noticeWordingConflict: General policy says notify as soon as known and within5days, subject to force majeure; card guide says30days. Do not promise30days universally.
purchaseProtection.foreignGoodsClaim: Foreign-purchased goods require proof of eligible card purchase; claim must be made within Mexico under the policy.

extendedWarranty.settlement: Below60percent repair cost: covered parts/labor; at least60percent: article value subject to policy terms. Policy specifies primary bank-account reimbursement, while guide says card credit; settlement-channel discrepancy remains.

baggage.loss: Checked baggage formally declared lost and not recovered within45calendar days; outbound or return travel. Loss benefit additional to qualifying delay benefit, not an automatic payout for any damaged bag.
baggage.spouseAndDependentChildren: Spouse and dependent children younger than23 only while traveling with primary and tickets paid with eligible card; primary/additional eligibility subject to certificate.
baggage.awardTickets: Policy includes eligibleMR/AeromexicoRewards tickets only where all taxes paid with eligible card.
baggage.policySeparateArticleLimit: General policy states maximum3articles per card per365days from first event; do not convert this into3claim events or replace card-specific1event limit.

contractReview.method: Platinum all16pages read; GoldElite cover independently reviewed and all remaining15pages compared, identical after Unicode ligature/whitespace normalization. Product-specific cover fees remain separate.

benefitAnnex.warranty: Eligible goods purchased in Mexico/US; extension up to1year, original manufacturer warranty90days-2years. VAT not reimbursed. Services, animals, perishables and motor vehicles excluded, among others.
benefitAnnex.travelAccident: Up to250000USD accidental death while aboard authorized public transport with tickets paid by card. Annex specifies primary, spouse, dependent children older than12and younger than23, and additional cardholders; full policy controls eligibility/exclusions.
benefitAnnex.creditLife: Outstanding account balance on PRIMARY death, proof required; not additional-cardholder death cover or post-primary-death additional purchases.

rewards.enrollment: Automatic, no separate program fee; account must remain active/current. Additional-card purchases accrue to primary program account; only primary redeems.
rewards.conversion: Each eligible transaction converted to USD using the exchange rate in force on transaction day. Reward conversion is not a promise of fee-free FX billing.
rewards.rounding: Nearest whole point per transaction: USD fractional .01-.49 down and .50-.99 up.

installmentEarning.merchantMSI: Proportional points as each installment posts
installmentEarning.automaticMSI: Points accrue on original purchase, not again on subsequent installments
